---
title: "M11 · Data Engineering & Orchestration"
subtitle: "Data · 10 of 10 lessons ready"
---

**Prerequisites:** [M07 SQL & Databases](m07.qmd), [M02 Software Engineering Practices](m02.qmd) · **GPU:** none

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | [The Modern Data Stack & ELT Physics](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/01-The%20Modern%20Data%20Stack%20&%20ELT%20Physics.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | ETL vs ELT, warehouse layers (raw/staging/marts), a complete measured ELT pipeline into DuckDB, and the cost of moving vs. transforming data. |
| 02 | [Dimensional Data Modeling (Kimball)](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/02-Dimensional%20Data%20Modeling%20(Kimball).ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Bus matrix and conformed dimensions, transaction/snapshot/accumulating facts, SCD types 1-3 in SQL, degenerate and junk dimensions on Chinook. |
| 03 | [Transformations with dbt (Data Build Tool)](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/03-Transformations%20with%20dbt%20(Data%20Build%20Tool).ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | A real dbt project on DuckDB: sources, seeds, staging and mart models, ref(), generic and singular tests, incremental models, docs and run results. |
| 04 | [Data Ingestion with dlt](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/04-Data%20Ingestion%20with%20dlt.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | REST API ingestion with dlt resources and pipelines: schema inference, nested-data normalisation, schema evolution, incremental cursors and merge loads. |
| 05 | [Apache Airflow Foundations](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/05-Apache%20Airflow%20Foundations.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | A real Airflow 3 instance in Docker: TaskFlow DAGs, scheduler and executors, XComs, triggering and monitoring runs through the REST API, catchup and retries. |
| 06 | [Advanced Airflow Orchestration](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/06-Advanced%20Airflow%20Orchestration.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Dynamic task mapping, branching and trigger rules, reschedule-mode sensors, retries and scheduler-managed backfills on Airflow 3. |
| 07 | [Airflow 3: What Changed](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/07-Airflow%203%20-%20What%20Changed.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Task SDK, API-based task execution, asset-triggered DAGs, DAG versioning through REST API v2, and an Airflow 2 to 3 migration checklist. |
| 08 | [Asset-Based Orchestration with Dagster](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/08-Asset-Based%20Orchestration%20with%20Dagster.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Software-defined assets and dependencies, materialisation metadata, asset checks, daily partitions and backfills, asset- vs task-based orchestration. |
| 09 | [Incremental Data Loading Physics](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/09-Incremental%20Data%20Loading%20Physics.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | High-water marks vs. full reloads (measured), idempotent MERGE and delete-insert loads, CDC inserts/updates/deletes, and lookback windows for late data. |
| 10 | [Data Quality via Great Expectations](../../M11-Data%20Engineering%20&%20Orchestration/10-Data%20Quality%20via%20Great%20Expectations.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | GX data context, sources and batches, expectation suites for completeness, validity, uniqueness and distribution, checkpoints and failing a pipeline on bad data. |
